import os,pathlib,fcntl,time,json,sys

def sample():
 v=list(map(int,next(x for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/stat').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('cpu13 ')).split()[1:]))[:8];return sum(v),v[3]+v[4]

m=dict((x.split(':')[0],x.split(':')[1].strip()) for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines());assert int(m['MemAvailable'].split()[0])>2*1024*1024
v=os.statvfs('/mnt/clathrin');assert v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize>1<<30;p.mkdir(mode=0o700);print(json.dumps({'CPU13busy':busy,'memory_available':m['MemAvailable'],'scratch_free_bytes':v.f_bavail*v.f_frsize,'fresh':str(p)}))
